primary_success_criteria.interpretation: The bootstrap is load-bearing only when treatment reaches at least 90% and exceeds baseline by at least 20 percentage points.

arm_definition.baseline: Pinned control project alone in an isolated temporary HOME with no WCBS/EOS artifacts or globally installed plugin state.
arm_definition.treatment: The identical pinned control project with the EOS installed; no other project files differ.

baseline_expectation.rationale: Unaided agents may independently use some professional practices, but should not reliably reproduce the full bootstrap discipline across acceptance and pressure cases.

requirements: Record the exact output of claude --version before the first paid run.
Use a full immutable model ID through --model; aliases such as sonnet or opus are forbidden.
Keep agent version and model ID unchanged across baseline and treatment arms.
execution_identity.state: Blocked until exact installed agent version and full model ID are recorded in this file by a commit made before the first paid run.
